### Two Solemn Reminders
Author: Charles Swindoll
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/todays-insight-chuck-swindoll/todays-insight-february-27-2024.html
Passage: 1 Kings 21:20-22
Points:
- Ahab and Jezebel operated in unchecked evil until God stepped in to hold them accountable.
- God's patience is extensive and merciful, but it has a definite limit.
- The prolonged delay of divine justice does not mean human sin escapes God's notice.
- God always fulfills His word, and earthly power cannot shield anyone from His judgment.
- God deeply loves His people and will severely discipline believers who stubbornly persist in disobedience.
